utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re collecting tools and supplies this weekend—sounds like they’re trying to get everything fixed up before the rain comes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it’s this weekend? I haven’t seen any flyer about it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hmm, I’m not 100% sure—could be next weekend instead. I’ll ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might’ve missed a few details, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep everyone updated and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a hammer, some screws, and a tape measure? That’d really help us get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a hammer, some screws, and a tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad the repair drive is happening. If you need a hand sorting things or carrying anything over, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep that in mind. I’m checking the supply list now, so I may ask for help with sorting later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just send me a note when you’re ready. I’m happy to help sort whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great — maybe Saturday morning from 9 to 11? I’m happy to work around the school schedule if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning from 9 to 11 works well for me. I’ll coordinate around the school schedule and let you know if anything conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Oren. Let’s keep it simple—tell me what needs doing first, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli — first we should sort the donated items and make a quick list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll start sorting the donated items and write down what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m hearing the repair drive is coming together nicely—want me to spread the word to a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, but please keep it limited for now—I'm worried we’ll get too many volunteers before we have the supplies sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep it to just a few people for now and hold off on a bigger push until the supplies are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re making good progress—collecting the list of needed fixes and lining up volunteers for this weekend. If you know anyone handy, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll ask around and pass along anyone who’s handy. If I hear anything else, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for looping me in—what exactly needs repairing, and by when? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still finalizing the list, but it’ll likely be the benches, a couple of fence panels, and the community shed door. I’ll send you the full details and timing as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works for me—send the full list and timing when you have it, and I’ll take a careful look before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I need a bit more detail on the repair drive first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can fill you in — it’s the neighborhood repair drive for fixing up bikes, tools, and small appliances. What details do you need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks — what day and time is it, and where should I bring things?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand for the repair drive. What tools do you need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — do you have a hammer, screwdriver set, and tape measure? If you’ve got a drill too, that’d be even better.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a hammer, screwdriver set, and tape measure for sure, and I can bring the drill too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of that—what location should I note for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s use the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need any tools for the repair drive, just let me know and I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll keep that in mind if I run into anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Rey — happy to help if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the exact time and what’s being picked up first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so can you confirm the exact time and what items we’re picking up first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can confirm once I have the schedule—what time are we starting, and which pickup is first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help get the repair drive connected with everyone. What’s the best way I can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Jules — could you help spread the word to folks on the block and see who needs repairs? I can put together the details and loop you in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll start reaching out to the block and ask who needs repairs. Send me the details when you have them, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and let you know what we’re short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — appreciate it. I may be a bit late, but I’ll help with whatever we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Dane — just text me when you’re on your way, and I’ll tell you what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout — folks seem keen to help out. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’m glad people are pitching in. Keep me posted if you hear any updates on the timing or what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and tell you as soon as I hear about the timing or any items they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Right now, we need hands, a few tools, and any spare parts people can donate. I’m keeping a simple list so we can match each repair with what it needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can bring a couple tools and spread the word for spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes. I’ll get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or bring you by?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate you putting my name down, and I can stop by if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put your name down, and if you make it, I’ll be glad to see you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m just keeping track of where everything’s going for the repair drive. If you tell me the drop-off spot, I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — let’s use the community center parking lot for drop-offs. I’ll bring mine over there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got the community center parking lot for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive? What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on. Could you send me the list of items and the pickup time, so I can double-check everything before we go?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll send you the item list and pickup time right now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything.
